name: Crepes and Coffee (Garden City) Savory Ham, Egg & Cheese or Turkey-Avocado Crepe
brandOrRestaurant: Crepes and Coffee (Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
whyItWorks: Paper-thin egg-and-flour French crepes folded around scrambled eggs, lean ham or turkey breast, avocado, and melted cheese—a huge gut relief from heavy Bear Lake burger grease.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Ham, Scrambled Egg & Cheese Crepe or the Turkey, Avocado & Cheese Crepe on standard white batter (or gluten-free buckwheat if tolerated).
watchOuts: Hold raw spinach or tomatoes if flaring
